source: W11 chunked DC-only JPEG reused byte-for-byte plus a new streamed 8-bit grayscale PNG of the identical raster

items.method: streamed DC-only grayscale baseline JPEG; 64 KiB entropy chunks; Q=8; block level=48+20*((3*bx+5*by+(bx^by)) mod 9); no full-frame raster
streamed 8-bit grayscale PNG: one filter-0 row (4096 bytes) at a time, chunked deflate with a fixed producer level, CRC32 per chunk, IHDR/IDAT/IEND only; no full-frame raster buffer; exclusive create

pixel_equality: all 16,777,216 input pixels of both fixtures equal the fixed DC/block-coordinate raster
png_producer: w12_png_fixture.PNG_ID; streamed filter-0 rows, chunked deflate level 6, CRC per chunk, exclusive create
